About Me

Agricultural & Industrial Real Estate Expert

I specialize in the purchase, sale and investment in agro-industrial and commercial real estate in Ukraine, Europe, UAE and Oman. I work with agricultural land, orchards, farms, port complexes, warehouse and industrial property, mineral extraction sites and ready businesses.

I accompany transactions from asset search to deal closing, including legal, financial and due diligence support. My geography covers Ukraine, Romania, Europe, UAE and Oman.

I operate as part of LARGOS — a specialized agro-industrial real estate agency with full legal and audit support.
